title: Jurassic World Park Map (2015)
description: The official in-universe visitor map of the Jurassic World theme park on Isla Nublar, as seen in Jurassic World (2015), designed in-story by graphic designer Ellen Lampl. Archived and documented on the Jurassic Park Wiki.

title: Isla Nublar
description: Overview and cartography of Isla Nublar, the primary island setting of Jurassic Park (1993) and Jurassic World (2015), located roughly 120 miles west of Costa Rica.

title: Jurassic Park / World Park Map (general)
description: Reference page collecting the various official park maps that have appeared across the Jurassic Park and Jurassic World films.

title: Jurassic-Pedia: Film Location Maps
description: Jurassic-Pedia is a long-running fan-run encyclopedia of the franchise; this category collects fan-researched and reconstructed maps of filming and in-universe locations.

title: Jurassic World Orlando Map (fan concept)
description: A fan-made recreation/concept map by artist JoshuaDunlop imagining a Jurassic World park map, hosted on DeviantArt.

title: Jurassic Park Wiki (ParkPedia)
description: The largest community-run Jurassic encyclopedia ("ParkPedia"), hosted on Fandom. Covers every film, TV series, novel, comic, video game and toy line, plus detailed pages on characters, locations and every on-screen creature.

title: Jurassic-Pedia
description: A long-running unofficial, canon-focused encyclopedia of the franchise, written in an in-universe style and carefully sourced to the films, novels and supporting material.

title: Jurassic Outpost
description: The main Jurassic Park / Jurassic World fan-news site (a 2016 rebrand of JurassicWorld.org), covering announcements, set news, interviews and merchandise, and home of the InGeneral podcast.

title: The Jurassic Wiki (Jurassic Outpost Encyclopedia)
description: The encyclopedia companion to Jurassic Outpost, cataloguing the franchise's films, creatures, characters and production history.

title: Jurassic Park Institute Wiki
description: A dinosaur-focused Fandom wiki named after Universal's original 2001-2006 Jurassic Park Institute website, concentrating on the prehistoric animals of the franchise and their real-world counterparts.

title: Jurassic World Evolution Wiki
description: Fandom wiki for Frontier Developments' Jurassic World Evolution park-management game series, with data on every buildable species, building and mechanic.

title: Jurassic World Alive Wiki
description: Fandom wiki for Ludia's location-based AR mobile game Jurassic World Alive, covering its creatures, hybrids, stats and live events.

title: Jurassic World: The Game Wiki
description: Fandom wiki for Ludia's park-builder mobile game Jurassic World: The Game, documenting its roster of dinosaurs, hybrids and tournaments.

title: Wikipedia: Jurassic Park (franchise)
description: Wikipedia's real-world overview of the whole franchise - films, novels, box office, cast and production history - with citations to reliable sources.

title: Wikipedia: Dinosaurs in Jurassic Park
description: Wikipedia's dedicated article listing and describing every dinosaur and prehistoric creature to appear across the Jurassic Park films, with notes on their scientific accuracy.
